positive_cases.policy: Only reviewed carrier connecting-journey and bounded personal booking scoping; no general destination or unlimited PNR propagation.

mutation_matrix.change: Add original scoped cancellation for target leg
mutation_matrix.expected: No promotion; keep cancellation and originals

mutation_matrix.change: Add exact target manual other/hold decision
mutation_matrix.expected: No promotion; preserve decision and segment

mutation_matrix.change: Create pending or accepted share for target retained item
Clone complete matching operational dated leg with different primary PNR
mutation_matrix.expected: Ambiguous join stays held; no arbitrary first match

mutation_matrix.change: Add applicable explicit other traveler to target leg
mutation_matrix.expected: Hold; do not let weaker corroboration override

mutation_matrix.change: Change only survey person to another known traveler
Add known different traveler sharing owner's first name
Change survey carrier while keeping route/date
Change survey local travel day by one
Supersede indexed source with a contradictory or invalid current revision
mutation_matrix.expected: Currentness failure; no inherited stale authority

mutation_matrix.change: Survey source event precedes asserted flight completion
mutation_matrix.expected: Do not treat as post-travel evidence

mutation_matrix.change: Add unrelated dated leg months later with same PNR
mutation_matrix.expected: No unlimited booking or year-crossing propagation

mutation_matrix.change: Remove opposite airport or a required clock from operational source
mutation_matrix.expected: Retain partial evidence; do not fabricate completion

mutation_matrix.change: Keep name/date/place words but replace completed-travel assertion with offers
Only owner identity is destination email or footer

invariants: Both complete input orders converge in one bounded import cycle
Shuffled input order gives same final latest source schedule
Second import does not add segments, assertions or immutable evidence
Existing segment IDs/privacy/trip membership/shares/manual decisions survive outside intended additions
Synthetic fixture assertions must fail if zero positive recoveries
